# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen (in Volume 1)  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** President of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a handsome, tall boy with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a broad-shouldered, manly build. He has a clear, frank face and straightforward eyes, often wearing a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is clever, thoughtful, self-sacrificing, and popular among his peers. Good-natured and fond of teasing, he holds high ideals and approaches his goals with strong determination. He is hard-working and possesses a thoughtful depth that matches Anne Shirley's serious moods.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)_

- Strong academic student  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- To earn enough money teaching to put himself through college  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- To become a doctor and fight disease, pain, and ignorance  <sub>[v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014)</sub>
- To get the best out of life and put the best into it  <sub>[v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)</sub>
- To win Anne Shirley's love  <sub>[v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v2 c30 P42](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0042)</sub>

## History

After living in Alberta for three years with his ailing father, Gilbert returned to Avonlea and resumed his schooling, entering into an intense academic rivalry with Anne Shirley. He pursued Second Year work at Queen's Academy, successfully obtaining his First Class teacher's license in one year. Because his father could not afford to send him directly to college, Gilbert took a teaching position at White Sands. He generously surrendered his initial application for the Avonlea school to Anne so she could live at Green Gables with Marilla. In Avonlea, he was elected president of the Village Improvement Society and co-authored satirical local notes for the newspaper with Anne. After teaching for a year, he resigned his position at White Sands to prepare to attend Redmond College alongside Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c24 P1](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0001), [v2 c25 P70](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0070), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)_

- Lived in Alberta for three years due to his father's ill health and missed much schooling  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
